name: Klockmort's Essentials
summary: In Darnassus, Mathiel carries Klockmort Spannerspan's urgent plea across the sea. Bound to his post, Mathiel asks Alliance travelers to go to Ironforge and find his gnome friend in Tinkertown.

sections.title: A Call Across Continents
sections.body: Mathiel carries Klockmort Spannerspan's plea from Darnassus to Dun Morogh. Klockmort needs bold allies for a venture into Gnomeregan, but Mathiel cannot leave his post to travel to the mountain kingdom. From the Warrior's Terrace, he asks capable Alliance travelers passing through Darnassus to make the journey in his place.

sections.title: The Road to Tinkertown
sections.body: Klockmort Spannerspan works in Tinkertown, Ironforge's district for gnomes displaced by the fall of their underground city. He is planning to recover vital machinery left in Gnomeregan's contaminated corridors. Mathiel's referral leads you to Klockmort's workshop, where he needs help with the effort to reclaim what was left behind.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Klockmort's Essentials?
faq.answer: Mathiel gives the summons. The night elf cannot leave his post to travel to Ironforge, so he asks trusted Alliance travelers to go in his place and answer his gnome friend Klockmort Spannerspan's plea.

faq.q: Where do I find Klockmort Spannerspan?
faq.answer: Find Klockmort Spannerspan in Tinkertown, the gnomish district of Ironforge. Gnomes displaced from their lost home have set up workshops and other equipment there.

faq.q: Why does Klockmort need help in Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Klockmort needs help retrieving essential mechanical components from Gnomeregan. The city was overrun and irradiated by toxic fallout, and its ruins hold troggs, deranged leper gnomes, and haywire automata.

faq.q: Is this quest required to enter Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: No. Mathiel's summons offers a route to Klockmort Spannerspan, but you can speak with him in Ironforge and accept his assignments without the introduction.
After you speak with Klockmort Spannerspan, he directs you to Essential Artificials, which sends you deep inside Gnomeregan.

faq.q: Why is Mathiel interested in helping a gnome in Ironforge?
faq.answer: Mathiel and Klockmort are long-time personal friends. Though stationed far away and unable to leave his post, Mathiel seeks someone trustworthy to help his friend.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you carry Mathiel's appeal from Darnassus to Klockmort in Ironforge, joining night elf lands to the dwarven mountain halls in common defense.
As a gnome, you know that every call to Tinkertown helps in the ongoing struggle to reclaim your lost home of Gnomeregan.
